items.stem: Which approach keeps a chart in your deck current when the underlying Sheets data changes?

options.text: Insert the chart as a linked chart from Sheets
options.rationale: Correct: a linked chart can be updated to reflect the latest data.

options.text: Paste a screenshot of the chart
options.rationale: A screenshot is static and will not update.

options.text: Retype the numbers into a text box
options.rationale: Manual text does not stay in sync with the data.
Transitions are unrelated to data updates.

items.explanation: Correct: a linked chart can be updated to reflect the latest data.

items.stem: Which TWO choices improve the readability of a content slide? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Limit the slide to one key idea
options.rationale: Correct: one idea per slide keeps the message clear.

options.text: Use sufficient contrast between text and background
options.rationale: Correct: adequate contrast makes text legible.

options.text: Fill the slide with as much text as possible
Apply a different animation to every element
options.rationale: Excess animation distracts from the content.

items.explanation: Correct: one idea per slide and adequate contrast both improve readability.
